name: Fort Knox Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: 26 of its 48 pull-through sites are leased for the season (ResNexus, 2026-11-05); the rest sell by the night online. No tent camping, and a 2025 RV Life reviewer reports no staff on site. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site fortknoxcampground.com (©2026, phone 308-293-1044: 'we offer seasonal sites and daily sites', 'Campers and RV's only. No Tent Camping', season Apr 1-Oct 31) + its ResNexus engine (48 'Pull Through RV Sites' up to 100 ft, 50/30 A, water, sewer; 26 tagged 'This site is reserved for the season', 22 nightly, single nights, 6-month window, 30-night cap) + Google Maps 5.0 from 32 reviews with phone at the pin, read 2026-11-05 -> real private RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5 (~46% nightly, no application or long minimum, no homes); price gate: operator rate unreadable off-season (engine sells nothing until the 2027 season), RV Life reviewers paid $45 (8/2025, 6/2026, 9/2026) and $50 (9/2026), RV Life avg_rate $46 -> not over $50; no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery at 41.8098,-99.1820 (300 m and 900 m frames, rendered, read 2026-11-05): fenced gravel grid of N-S pull-through rows east of NE-96; the Calamus River bends past the campground's SW corner ~30-40 m from the westmost sites, across the campground's own perimeter loop road and open grass/sand with no treeline -> river visible from the SW sites, but the loop road between caps it at a view (AWH 2026-11-01 loop-road rule); the rest of the grid sits 100+ m from the water. riverview.
fees_source: No operator rate readable 2026-11-05: fortknoxcampground.com/Accommodations.html prints 'STARTING AT $ per night' with the number blank (filled only for bookable dates), and the ResNexus Search for 11/10/2026, 4/6/2027, 5/2-5/4/2027 and 5/4/2027 (2 guests) returned every site UNAVAILABLE with no price (off-season; daily sites open each April). Camper reports only (not usable as fees while the operator has a web page): RV Life reviews of park 267756, $45/night stayed 8/2025, 6/2026 (Good Sam discount), 9/2026 and $50/night 9/2026; RV Life price_level 3 ($$$), avg_rate 46.
flags: PRICE UNREAD: no 2024+ operator/engine rate obtainable off-season; added on dated RV Life camper reports $45-50 (2025-2026) and RV Life avg $46, none over $50. RV Life tier is $$$, so the price indicator is the working ResNexus booking page. Re-quote a summer weeknight on ResNexus once the 2027 season opens; drop if over $50.

Mostly seasonal: 26 of 48 RV sites carry ResNexus's 'This site is reserved for the season' photo; the 22 others (e.g. 16, 17, 25, which RV Life reviewers stayed on by the night) sell nightly -> passes test 4 (1 in 10) comfortably. Operator: 'Call for more info on seasonal leases April 1 - Oct 31'.

sites: 48 pull-through RV sites ('Pull Through RV Sites 48 Available' class in ResNexus; 2 more units are rental campers), all pull-through, 'up to 100 ft. in Length', 32x100 to 65x100 ft lots (fortknoxcampground.com Accommodations + ResNexus RoomDetails, read 2026-11-05). Max rig: none stated beyond 100-ft lots.

hookups: electric 50 (50 and 30 amps), water yes, sewer yes at every RV site (ResNexus site descriptions 'Pull Through Site · up to 100 ft. in Length · 50 and 30 Amps · Water and Sewer Hookups'; amenities 'Water Hydrant', 'Full Septic', read 2026-11-05)

booking: reservable online via ResNexus; 'Cannot make reservations more than 6 months in advance', 'Cannot reserve more than 30 nights at a time', 0 hours in advance minimum, single nights offered (ResNexus RoomDetails CalendarResources, read 2026-11-05); 'Daily sites are available to book starting April 1st every year!' (operator home page). No standing minimum stay found.
season: April 1 - October 31 ('Season runs April 1st-Oct 31st', fortknoxcampground.com, read 2026-11-05)
facilities: picnic table and fire ring at each site (operator); shower house, restrooms and a one-washer/one-dryer laundry per a 6/2026 RV Life reviewer (camper report, not operator)

Google Maps: 5.0 from 32 reviews, +1 308-293-1044, place at 41.81065,-99.18224 (~70 m from pin), 46377 NE-96 (gm.py 2026-11-05). Not in the Good Sam directory cache. Hipcamp listing ex9h1e5q no longer active (redirects to a search page).
Another RV/trailer park sits ~500 m NW across the Calamus River and NE-96 (north of the river, west of the highway); not this lead and not checked - possibly one of the other Burwell leads.
